sign.name: Limpid and opaque
sign.operation: Medium as he steps from the river, the light changing on him.

scenes.world: The riverbank in warm late-afternoon light, then a white cart road up between olive groves toward a walled town; travelogue landscape light.

captain.asks: Medium on the man as he steps from the river with the light changing on him, then the road up through groves to the town.
diagnosis: The transfiguration is the sign's core and the footage cannot do it: no man in the river changes light.
The road and the grove close cleanly: landscape travelogue gives one legible route to the town.
Modern intrusions keep leaking: sunglasses on the bank, a 1950s laundry room with a washing machine.
